name: Tapo P115 (EU)

radios.note: 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi 802.11b/g/n. The spec sheet we saw lists no Bluetooth; not confirmed either way.

matter.note: TP-Link's P115 pages don't mention Matter and no CSA listing was found. Not stated as unsupported either.

apple_home.note: TP-Link's P115 pages list Alexa and Google Assistant only; no page says Apple Home is unsupported.

google_home.note: Tapo's product page lists Google Assistant voice control through the Tapo account link.

alexa.note: Tapo's product page lists Amazon Alexa voice control through the Tapo skill.

smartthings.note: The EU product page lists only Alexa and Google. TP-Link's US P115 pages and its generic SmartThings FAQ mention SmartThings, but nothing EU-specific was found.

home_assistant.note: HA's TP-Link Smart Home integration covers Tapo devices; python-kasa, the library it uses, lists the P115 among Tapo plugs. The HA docs snippet we saw did not show the P115 row.

hubRequired.note: Wi-Fi plug set up in the Tapo app; no hub listed.

localControl.note: Tapo says devices on your LAN stay reachable in the Tapo app when the internet is down.

energyMonitoring.note: Tracks the energy use of connected devices; you can enter your electricity rate for cost estimates.

summary: The Tapo P115 is TP-Link's compact EU Wi-Fi plug with energy monitoring. TP-Link lists Alexa and Google Assistant, and Home Assistant's TP-Link integration covers Tapo plugs. It is rated 16 A / 3680 W and needs no hub.
